_: Settlement sheet for the Teeth of Sithis (lane 2.5c).

norms.text: The stone is scrubbed to the waterline as ritual; nothing is repaired or added.
An offering stays where it was laid.

taboos.text: Touching the stone beneath the waterline.
Moving an offering once it is laid.

values.text: Exact work done the same way each day.
Letting the lost purpose stay lost.

contempts.text: Claimants who say they have found the temple's purpose.

place.text: The largest Sithis temple in Murkmire, kept exact; its lost purpose is the teaching.

work.text: Scrubbing, watching and carrying offerings are the rite itself.

people.text: Outsiders come in only with the right offering.

faction.text: At least one faction claims to know the temple's purpose; the Clutch call that a grip held too tightly.

danger.text: The voriplasm in the flooded deep room is part of the temple; the leeches are the shallows' own.

directions.text: The pilgrim way ends here; Fourth Stage is a short walk north.

addressTerms.text: Pilgrim, for anyone who comes up from the landing.

neverSaid.text: A guess at what the temple was built to do.

grievances.text: A faction claims to have found the temple's purpose and wants the Clutch to hear it.

rumours.text: The old high priestess took the temple back once, long after Duskfall.

views.text: The order that holds the temple; the priests here keep its sermon in stone.

dissent.text: Scrubs the teeth down to the waterline each day and never past it; below the line is where the temple's dangers live.
